external_games.name: Hawaii High: Mystery of the Tiki

name: Hawaii High: Mystery of the Tiki
storyline: Jennifer, a teenager who recently relocated from New York City to Hawaii, teams up with her new local friend Maleah to track down a sacred Tiki god carving that has been stolen. Together they explore the island, solving puzzles and uncovering clues to recover the missing artifact.
summary: Hawaii High: Mystery of the Tiki is a computer game written and designed by famed comic book artist Trina Robbins. The game, set in Hawaii, is the first video game targeting girls. While the game was not a commercial success, some commentators noted that certain elements later appeared in games targeting girls.
